label: MA-4(1)
title: Logging and Review

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Log {{ insert: param, ma-4.1_prm_1 }} for nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic sessions; and

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Review the audit records of the maintenance and diagnostic sessions to detect anomalous behavior.

guidance: Audit logging for nonlocal maintenance is enforced by [AU-2](#au-2) . Audit events are defined in [AU-2a](#au-2_smt.a).

params.label: audit events
guidelines: audit events to be logged for nonlocal maintenance are defined;

params.label: audit events
guidelines: audit events to be logged for diagnostic sessions are defined;
